title: GroundElevationVolume
description: A volume defined by maximum and minimum ground elevation angles, clock angles, and radial limits.

show.description: Whether or not the entire volume is shown.

minimumGroundElevationAngle.description: The minimum ground elevation angle of the volume.

maximumGroundElevationAngle.description: The maximum ground elevation angle of the volume.

minimumClockAngle.description: The minimum clock angle limit of the volume.

maximumClockAngle.description: The maximum clock angle limit of the volume.

minimumRadius.description: The minimum radial limit of the volume.

maximumRadius.description: The maximum radial limit of the volume.

showIntersection.description: Whether or not the intersection of the volume with the Earth is shown.

intersectionColor.description: The color of the intersection of the volume with the Earth.

intersectionWidth.description: The width of the intersection in pixels.

showLateralSurfaces.description: Whether or not the lateral surfaces, i.e., the outer sides of the volume, are shown.

lateralSurfaceMaterial.description: The material to use for the volume's lateral surface, i.e., the outer sides of the volume.

showEllipsoidSurfaces.description: Whether or not ellipsoid surfaces are shown.

ellipsoidSurfaceMaterial.description: The material to use for the volume's ellipsoid surfaces.

showDomeSurfaces.description: Whether or not dome surfaces are shown.

domeSurfaceMaterial.description: The material to use for the volume's dome surfaces.

environmentConstraint.description: Whether or not the volume will be occluded by objects in the current view of the environment, e.g. visible terrain or models.

showEnvironmentOcclusion.description: Whether or not the portion of the volume occluded by the environment will be drawn with the environmentOcclusionMaterial.

environmentOcclusionMaterial.description: The material to use for the portion of the volume occluded by the environment.

showEnvironmentIntersection.description: Whether or not a line showing where the volume intersects the environment will be drawn.

environmentIntersectionColor.description: The color of the intersection line between the volume and the environment.

environmentIntersectionWidth.description: The width in meters of the intersection line between the volume and the environment.

showThroughEllipsoid.description: Whether or not a volume intersecting the ellipsoid is drawn through the ellipsoid and potentially out to the other side.

showViewshed.description: Whether or not the viewshed of the volume will be drawn.

viewshedVisibleColor.description: The color of the scene geometry that is visible to the volume.

viewshedOccludedColor.description: The color of the scene geometry that is not visible to the volume.

viewshedResolution.description: The resolution in pixels of the viewshed.
